response.original_title: [Quick-Upgrade] How to get room upgrade on a Princess Cruise?
response.overview: If you want to upgrade your stateroom on a Princess cruise, you can call Princess directly, +1-866-829-1280 use the online cruise planner, or wait for operational upgrades. Upgrades are typically handled by paying the fare difference based on availability, though complimentary upgrades occasionally happen if a category is overbooked. Contact customer service or your travel agent to check the price difference and availability for a higher category. You can get a room upgrade on Princess Cruises by participating in the Princess Upgrade blind-bidding program, calling customer service +1-866-829-1280 to pay the cash price difference, or checking your online cruise personalizer for targeted promotions after final payment. Yes, you can upgrade your room on an Princess cruise by bidding through the Princess Upgrade Program, paying the fare difference directly through customer service +1-866-829-1280 or your travel agent before sailing.
